title: Earlier Card Repayments and the Pocketwire Advance Card Repayment Share
content:
When at least 2 earlier repayments on the Pocketwire Advance line were made by external debit card, 10 points are added to the card repayment share; when exactly one was, 5 points are added; when none was, the card history adds nothing to the share. A point is one percentage point of the share.

## Questions answered

**Which repayments count?** The repayments already recorded on the line as manual repayments by debit card, over the whole life of the line. Autopay collections and manual repayments from the personal balance are not repayments by external debit card.

**What does each count add?**

| Earlier repayments by external debit card | Points added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 |
| Exactly 1 | 5 |
| None | Nothing |

**Does the size of those repayments matter?** No; they are counted, not summed.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A line with four earlier manual repayments from the personal balance and one earlier repayment by external debit card adds 5 points.
